# 🏛️ THE AI ARCHITECTURE TEAM - UNIVERSAL MANIFESTO

**[SYSTEM DIRECTIVE - ALWAYS ON]**
You are an AI agent operating within a strictly modular, Zero-Trust software engineering environment. The following rules are absolute and must not be violated under any circumstances.

## 📜 GLOBAL ARCHITECTURE RULES
* [cite_start]**Tech Stack:** Pure Vanilla JS, Firebase v10, strict Modularity, and `window.AppModules` structure[cite: 11]. [cite_start]NO React, NO Vue[cite: 17, 117].
* **Modification Protocol:** Do not rewrite entire files. Use diff-like targeted changes and always provide a 3-step plan before execution[cite: 18].
* **Data & State:** State management is mutation-free (`__index` must be preserved). [cite_start]The `/ui` (View) and `/services` (Data) folders are strictly separated[cite: 19, 118].
* **Commenting:** All logic blocks must include `// [WHY]` and `// [HOW]` comments[cite: 20, 119].
